properties.text: KEEP POINTER CENTERED TO AVOID EXHAUST SMOKE

Your objective is to reach the finish line first. When the traffic lights turn [color=#ff0000]RED[/color], stop immediately, as the scarecrow will turn around to check for movement. If it sees you move, you’re out. While it is watching, keep the slider centered to avoid releasing exhaust smoke, or the scarecrow will spot that too.

[color=#ffff00]\[Left][/color]/[color=#ffff00]\[Right][/color]: Turn the tractor / Move the slider
[color=#ffff00]\[Up][/color]: Accelerate                  [color=#ffff00]\[Down][/color]: Brake / Reverse

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] to start...
